items.name: Regular half-and-half, 2/3 US cup (brand unknown)
items.note: Reported used instead of 2/3 cup water in oatmeal. Assumes regular dairy half-and-half, not fat-free or heavy cream. Brand unknown; manufacturer proxy Horizon Organic Half & Half, retrieved November 10 2026: per 2 tbsp (30 mL), 40 kcal, protein 1 g, total carbs 1 g, fat 3 g, saturated fat 2 g, sugar 1 g, sodium 15 mg, cholesterol 15 mg; fiber and added sugar not significant. 2/3 US cup = 10 2/3 tbsp = 5 1/3 label servings. All half-and-half nutrients estimated, not a confirmed personal product label. Source: https://horizon.com/organic-dairy-products/organic-half-and-half/organic-half-and-half/
